LAREDO, Texas — Texas A&M International University’s Center for the Fine and Performing Arts (CFPA) has opened its free Fall 2026 performance season — and the season’s first marquee event, the Parameters Student Art Show, opens tonight at 6 p.m. in the CFPA Gallery, according to TAMIU.

The lineup runs through Dec. 1 and covers live music, theatre and dance, mostly in the CFPA Recital Hall and CFPA Theatre. Highlights include a jazz band concert Nov. 4 at 6 p.m. in the CFPA Theatre, a Shakespeare block Nov. 6–12 (including Twelfth Night Nov. 7 and a silent-movie screening with organ accompaniment Nov. 12), the Fall Dance Concert Nov. 13, and the Guitarras De Navidad concert closing the season Dec. 1.

Free for everyone

Every event is free and open to the public, and donations accepted at the door go directly to scholarships for TAMIU fine and performing arts students. The full updated schedule is posted at go.tamiu.edu/fpaevents. For details, the Department of Fine and Performing Arts can be reached at 956.326.2654 or at tamiu.edu/coas/fpa.

Sources:

  • TAMIU: “TAMIU Fine and Performing Arts Readies for Fall 2026 Performance Season, Student Art Exhibit” (Oct. 15, 2026)
